And to Adam He said: “Because you have listened to the voice of your wife and have eaten from the tree of which I commanded you not to eat, cursed is the ground because of you; through toil you will eat of it all the days of your life.

You have set our iniquities before You, our secret sins in the light of Your presence.

No temptation has seized you except what is common to man. And God is faithful; He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, He will also provide an escape, so that you can stand up under it.

xrefs.text: Many, O LORD my God, are the wonders You have done, and the plans You have for us— none can compare to You— if I proclaim and declare them, they are more than I can count.
He does great things beyond searching out, and wonders without number.
For You are great and perform wonders; You alone are God.
Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

verses.text: He gives rain to the earth and sends water upon the fields.

xrefs.text: Yet He has not left Himself without testimony to His goodness: He gives you rain from heaven and fruitful seasons, filling your hearts with food and gladness.
They have not said in their hearts, ‘Let us fear the LORD our God, who gives the rains, both autumn and spring, in season, who keeps for us the appointed weeks of harvest.’
You attend to the earth and water it; with abundance You enrich it. The streams of God are full of water, for You prepare our grain by providing for the earth.

Can the worthless idols of the nations bring rain? Do the skies alone send showers? Is this not by You, O LORD our God? So we put our hope in You, for You have done all these things.

verses.text: He sets the lowly on high, so that mourners are lifted to safety.

He has brought down rulers from their thrones, but has exalted the humble.
But He lifts the needy from affliction and increases their families like flocks.
Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.
The LORD sends poverty and wealth; He humbles and He exalts.

verses.text: He thwarts the schemes of the crafty, so that their hands find no success.

xrefs.text: Though they intend You harm, the schemes they devise will not prevail.
The LORD frustrates the plans of the nations; He thwarts the devices of the peoples.
Devise a plan, but it will be thwarted; state a proposal, but it will not happen. For God is with us.
There is no wisdom, no understanding, no counsel that can prevail against the LORD.
For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.

verses.text: He catches the wise in their craftiness, and sweeps away the plans of the cunning.

xrefs.text: The nations have fallen into a pit of their making; their feet are caught in the net they have hidden.
For the wisdom of this world is foolishness in God’s sight. As it is written: “He catches the wise in their craftiness.”
For it is written: “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise; the intelligence of the intelligent I will frustrate.”
He has dug a hole and hollowed it out; he has fallen into a pit of his own making.
He has performed mighty deeds with His arm; He has scattered those who are proud in the thoughts of their hearts.

verses.text: They encounter darkness by day and grope at noon as in the night.

verses.text: Blessed indeed is the man whom God corrects; so do not despise the discipline of the Almighty.

xrefs.text: Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love Him.
Blessed is the man You discipline, O LORD, and teach from Your law,

verses.text: For He wounds, but He also binds; He strikes, but His hands also heal.

xrefs.text: Come, let us return to the LORD. For He has torn us to pieces, but He will heal us; He has wounded us, but He will bind up our wounds.
See now that I am He; there is no God besides Me. I bring death and I give life; I wound and I heal, and there is no one who can deliver from My hand.
He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.

The light of the moon will be as bright as the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter— like the light of seven days— on the day that the LORD binds up the brokenness of His people and heals the wounds He has inflicted.

verses.text: He will rescue you from six calamities; no harm will touch you in seven.
